patch: if meets and (best is None or cost_day < best["cost_per_day"]): -> if meets and (best is None or cost_day <= best["cost_per_day"]):

inputs_tried: kwh price scanned ulp by ulp from 0.05/K50 (tie found at 0.012022669199125837)

should_fail: tests/features.py: the _dhw_setpoint_sweep block (~20133-20260) compares recommendations at ordinary prices only; it lacks a tie case (a candidate whose unrounded cost equals the stored rounded best) asserting the lower setpoint is kept.

finding.title: No check pins the sweep's tie-break; `<` -> `<=` hands a cost tie to the hotter setpoint unseen
finding.claim: _dhw_setpoint_sweep keeps the first (cooler) candidate on a cost tie. The comparison reads the unrounded cost against the best's rounded cost_per_day, so a tie is reachable on a continuous input: at a recent kWh price of 0.012022669199125837 SEK candidate 50's cost equals candidate 48's stored 0.05. With `<=` the recommendation moves 48 -> 50. The full gate does not notice.
finding.metric_definition: dhw_advisor recommended_setpoint at the tie price the probe finds, every window's learned draw reservoir twenty 0.0 kWh occurrences
